_comment: No secrets live here on purpose - connection string, JWT signing key and RabbitMQ connection string are supplied via the AquaFlow.WebAPI/.env file (see .env.example) or environment variables, never hardcoded in this file or in source. Program.cs fails fast at start-up if the connection string or JWT settings are missing everywhere in the config chain.

RabbitMQ._comment: Optional, unlike ConnectionStrings/JwtToken below - left blank on purpose. With no RabbitMQ connection string configured, the API registers a no-op message publisher and every other feature keeps working. Override with the RabbitMQ__ConnectionString environment variable or .env.

Firebase._comment: Left blank on purpose - do NOT commit a real service account JSON here. Override locally with the Firebase__ServiceAccountJson (inline JSON) or Firebase__ServiceAccountJsonPath (file path) and Firebase__ProjectId environment variables. Unlike ConnectionStrings/JwtToken above, a missing value here does not stop the API from starting - push notifications are a secondary feature and silently no-op instead.
